statistical_metrics.icc: Intraclass Correlation Coefficient - measures inter-rater reliability
statistical_metrics.consistency_rate: Percentage of runs selecting same winner
statistical_metrics.winner_margin: Gap between 1st and 2nd place - measures decision stability
